charts.title: Size of the worldwide market for dietary supplements from 2018 to 2028 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Size of the worldwide market for dietary supplements 2018-2028
charts.description: The global dietary supplement market is forecast to reach a market value of 185.1 billion U.S. dollars in 2025. In 2021, it was estimated to be worth around 137 billion U.S. dollars. The market has been growing since 2018 and is expected to continue to grow till 2028.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2018 to 2028; *Year of data release Read more

charts.title: Import value of vitamins worldwide in 2023, by country (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Import value of vitamins worldwide in 2023, by country
charts.description: In 2023, the United States was the leading worldwide importer of vitamin products in the world. The country imported vitamins worth 1.2 billion U.S. dollars. Three European countries followed the U.S. in import values of vitamins. Germany, the Netherlands, and Spain had a combined import value of about 1.6 billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Production volume of food supplements in Germany from 2019 to 2023 (in 1,000 tons)
charts.short: Production volume of food supplements Germany 2019-2023
charts.description: In 2023, approximately 204,080 tons of food supplements were produced in Germany. This represents a slight decrease in production volume compared to the previous year.  Different vitamins and minerals were the most popular food supplements in Germany.

charts.title: Number of companies producing food supplements in Germany from 2019 to 2023
charts.short: Number of companies producing food supplements Germany 2019-2023
charts.description: Food supplements have become increasingly important in recent years. This can be recognized above all by the increasing production volume of this food sector. The number of companies in the production of food supplements has also risen across Germany, from 52 in 2019 to 67 in 2023

charts.title: Revenue from food supplements¹ in Germany from 2018 bis 2023 (in billion euros²)
charts.short: Revenue from food supplements Germany 2018-2023
charts.description: In 2022, German pharmacies generated around 2.96 billion euros in revenue through food supplement sales. Figures increased annually during the timeline at hand.

charts.title: Year-on-year revenue development for food supplements¹ in Germany from 2019 to 2023
charts.short: Year-on-year revenue development for food supplements Germany 2019-2023
charts.description: In 2022, German pharmacies recorded a 1.3 percent growth in revenue from food supplement sales. This was a decrease compared to the previous year's 3.5 percent growth.

charts.title: Number of warnings issued for food products in Germany in 2022 and 2023, by product category
charts.short: Number of warnings issued for food products Germany 2022-2023, by product category
charts.description: In 2023, there were 38 official warnings issued for herbs and spices in Germany. This was more than a threefold increase compared to the year before. More warnings were also issued for milk and milk products.
charts.source: Bundesamt für Verbraucherschutz und Lebensmittelsicherheit Number of issued warnings

charts.title: Revenue of Orthomol Holding GmbH in Germany from 2015 to 2022 (in million euros)
charts.short: Orthomol Holding GmbH revenue Germany 2015-2022
charts.description: In 2022, Orthomol's global turnover totaled 153.57 million euros. Compared to previous years, sales have increased. Orthomols's core business is products for nutritional supplements and dietary support. The company's brands include Orthomol and Orthomed.

charts.title: Peripheral product range in pharmacies in Germany in 2022, by revenue (in billion euros)
charts.short: Peripheral product range in pharmacies Germany 2022, by revenue
charts.description: In 2022, German pharmacies generated around one billion euros in revenue through selling dermatological products. Total revenue from the peripheral product range sold in pharmacies that year amounted to around 5.38 billion euros.
categories: Dermatological¹ products (body care, cosmetics, sun protection)

charts.title: Best-selling over the counter medicine in Germany in 2022, by type (in million euros)
charts.short: Best-selling over the counter medicine Germany 2022, by type
charts.description: Cold and flu medicine had the highest revenue out of all over-the-counter medications in German pharmacies in 2022. It made 897 million euros that year. The next two most popular categories were basic painkillers and cough medicine, with revenues of 655 million euros and 522 million euros respectively.

charts.title: Best-selling over the counter medicine in Germany in 2022, by type (in million packaging units)
charts.short: Best-selling over the counter medicine Germany 2022, by type and units sold
charts.description: In 2022, cold and flu medicine sold 149 million packaging units, topping the list. Painkillers were next in demand, selling 130 million units.
charts.source: IQVIA Sales in million packaging units

charts.title: Best-selling over the counter medicine prescribed by a doctor in Germany in 2022, by type (in million euros)
charts.short: Best-selling over the counter medicine prescribed by a doctor Germany 2022, by type
charts.description: In 2022, mineral nutrients prescribed by a doctor were the top-selling over the counter medicine in Germany. Other leading medicine categories in this ranking included stomach and digestive medicine, as well as laxatives.

charts.title: Best-selling over the counter medicine prescribed by a doctor in Germany in 2022, by type (in million packaging units)
charts.short: Over the counter prescribed medicine Germany 2022, by type and units sold
charts.description: In 2022, general painkillers prescribed by a doctor in Germany sold 14 million units in the over the counter category. Vascular occlusion medicine, as well as cold and flu treatments, each sold 11 million units.
charts.source: IQVIA Sales in million packaging units

charts.title: Sales of vitamins in Germany in 2019/2020 and 2021/2022, by type (in million packaging units)
charts.short: Sales volume of vitamins Germany 2019-2022, by type
charts.description: Vitamin C generated the highest sales by far in Germany in 2021/2022, with around 32.8 million packaging units sold. However, this was a decrease compared to the time span before. A drop in sales volume was recorded for more than half of the vitamin types shown in the ranking.
charts.note: Germany; 2019/20 and 2021/22; April to March of the following year
charts.source: Lebensmittelverband Deutschland Sales in million packaging units
categories: Vitamin A/D, pure and both combined

charts.title: Sales of mineral nutrients in Germany in 2019/2020 and 2021/2022, by type (in million packaging units)
charts.short: Sales volume of mineral nutrients Germany 2019-2022, by type
charts.description: Magnesium generated the highest sales by far in Germany in 2021/2022, with around 33.5 million packaging units sold. However, this was a decrease compared to the period before.
charts.note: Germany; 2019/20 and 2021/22; April to March of the following year
charts.source: Lebensmittelverband Deutschland Sales in million packaging units

charts.title: Consumer price index for vitamin tablets or similar in Germany from 2020 bis 2023 (index year 2020 = 100)
charts.short: Consumer price index for vitamin tablets or similar Germany 2020-2023
charts.description: In 2023, the consumer price index for vitamin tablets was 113.1. This means that prices grew by around 13 percent compared to 2020. Annual increases were recorded during the timeline at hand.

charts.title: Production value of vitamins in Germany from 2009 to 2023 (in billion euros)
charts.short: Production value of vitamins Germany 2009-2023
charts.description: In 2023, German vitamin production was valued at around 4.7 billion euros. This was a significant increase compared to the year before, with figures also increasing annually during this specified timeline. In 2009, the vitamin production in Germany was valued at only 1.86 billion euros.

charts.title: Number of vitamin production companies in Germany from 2009 to 2023
charts.short: Number of vitamin production companies Germany 2009-2023
charts.description: In 2023, there were 47 companies in Germany producing vitamin supplements. Numbers decreased during the timeline shown. In 2009, the number of vitamin-producing companies was still at 60.

charts.title: Export and import volume of provitamins and vitamins in Germany from 2008 to 2023 (in tons)
charts.short: Export and import volume of provitamins and vitamins Germany 2008-2023
charts.description: In 2023, Germany exported around 72,000 tons of provitamins and vitamins. Around 59,940 tons of both were imported.
charts.note: Germany; 2008 to 2023; * Preliminary. To access this statistic, click the web link and type the code "51000-005" into the search bar. Figures ("Provitamins, vitamins") are filed under the label WA2936. Read more

charts.title: Leading food supplements consumed in Germany in 2023
charts.short: Most popular food supplements in Germany 2023
charts.description: In 2023, the most consumed food supplements in Germany were vitamins, with 60 percent of consumers confirming this via a survey. Vitamins were followed by minerals and proteins in the top three.
charts.note: Germany; April 2022 to March 2023; 6,018 respondents; 18-64 years
charts.source: Statista Consumer Insights Share of respondents
categories: Food supplements of animal origin (e.g. fish oil)
I have not consumed any food supplements

charts.title: Leading vitamin brands in Germany in 2022, by number of consumers (in 1,000s)
charts.short: Leading vitamin brands Germany 2022, by type
charts.description: In 2022, the leading vitamin brands in Germany were Abtei, tetesept and taxofit. Around 5.8 million consumers bought Abtei products.
charts.note: Germany; 2022; 10,089 respondents; 15 years and older; Computer-assisted web interviews (CAWI)
charts.source: Kantar Number of people in thousands

charts.title: Number of vitamin consumers in Germany in 2022, by frequency (in 1,000s)
charts.short: Number of vitamin consumers Germany 2022, by frequency
charts.description: In 2022, around 12.38 million people in Germany consumed vitamins and other food supplements once daily. Around 4.86 million did so two to three times a week.
charts.note: Germany; 2022; 10,089 respondents; 15 years and older; Computer-assisted web interviews (CAWI)
categories: Two to three times a week
Once a month or less often
Two to three times a month

charts.title: Number of vitamin consumers in Germany in 2022, by type (in 1,000s)
charts.short: Number of vitamin consumers Germany 2022, by type
charts.description: In 2022, around 13.55 million people in Germany consumed mineral supplements such as iron or zinc. Roughly 10 million consumers took multivitamins.
charts.note: Germany; 2022; 10,089 respondents; 15 years and older; Computer-assisted web interviews (CAWI)
charts.source: Kantar Number of people in thousands
categories: Natural products (based on herbs, plants, berries etc.)

charts.title: Where do you buy food supplements (vitamin products, minerals)?
charts.short: Locations for food supplement purchases in Germany in 2022
charts.description: Most German consumers bought their food supplements from a drugstore in 2022. Other locations includes pharmacies and shopping online, e.g. on Amazon.

charts.title: What do you pay attention to when buying vitamins and minerals?
charts.short: Leading criteria when buying food supplements in Germany in 2022
charts.description: Food supplement quality was the most important purchase criteria for German consumers, with around 70 percent of respondents confirming this via a survey. 61 percent of respondents paid attention to the price, while around 58 percent looked at ingredients.
categories: Whether it is vegan, vegetarian or purely plant-based
Nothing, I buy what is available
